Welcome

WALES, MA
01081

Welcome

Welcome to the Town of Wales, MA Online Assessment Database.

The Town of Wales has completed updating our property values
for Fiscal Year 2019. These values reflect full and fair cash value as of
January 1, 2023.

The Fiscal Year 2024 Tax Rate has also been approved by
the Massachusetts Department of Revenue at $14.77 per thousand dollars of
valuation.

If you have any questions regarding your assessed value or
the data on your property please contact the Board of Assessors at 413-245-7571
ext.103. Office hours are Monday-Wednesday 9-1 . Thursday- by appointment

New Assessors: Leis Phinney (Bev Poirier’s replacement)

David Foote (Sue Cadieux’s replacement)

The Wales Board of Assessors hopes that you will find this
information convenient and helpful.

Thank you,

Bev Poirier

Leon Givner

Sue Cadieux

You may be prompted to install Silverlight (a free product from Microsoft) after you enter. Follow all the prompts to run the plug-in installer. In some cases, you may need to refresh or restart your browser. If you have any questions please call Vision customer support at 800-628-1013 x2.
